terms.gloss: starch, made from wheat; used to thicken a sauce
terms.comment: Cato and Apicius spell it amulum. Apicius thickens a sauce with it again and again (amulō obligāre), as we use cornflour.

phrases.latin: Cochlear amylī in aquā frīgidā dissolve, tum in jūs īnfunde.
phrases.english: Dissolve a spoonful of starch in cold water, then pour it into the sauce.

phrases.latin: amulum sīc facitō. silīginem pūrgātō bene
phrases.english: Make starch like this. Clean the wheat well

phrases.latin: et in caccabum mittis ut calefīat et amulō obligās
phrases.english: and you put it in a pot to heat, and thicken it with starch

phrases.latin: Paulum amylī ex maiziō in impēnsam adde, ut crassa fīat.
phrases.english: Add a little cornflour to the filling to thicken it.
